I see the `tls_process_ske_dhe` function. The bug here is a use-after-free. Let me look at the beginning of this function to understand the full flow. The issue is that when `EVP_PKEY_assign_DH(peer_tmp, dh)` succeeds, `dh` is owned by `peer_tmp`. Then in the `err:` path, `DH_free(dh)` is called even though `dh` was already assigned to `peer_tmp` (which is also freed via `EVP_PKEY_free(peer_tmp)`). This causes a double-free of the DH object.

Let me look at the beginning of the function.
